Container.Name: Vault
Container.Overview: Vault is a self-hosted, Dropbox-style file backup server. Multi-user with admin management, drag-and-drop uploads, folder support, and inline file preview. The first account registered becomes the admin.
Container.Requires: A running PostgreSQL instance (or add the Unraid PostgreSQL container and link it here via DATABASE_URL).

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port the Vault web interface is accessible on.

Config.Name: Uploads Directory
Config.Description: Where uploaded files are stored. Point this at a User Share.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Secret used to sign session cookies. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string. Replace host/user/password/dbname to match your setup.

Config.Name: UPLOAD_DIR
Config.Description: Path inside the container where uploaded files are stored. Must match the Uploads Directory volume target above.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal port the server listens on. Only change if you have a conflict.
